Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: McCaffrey, Lauren (NBCUniversal) <Lauren.McCaffrey@nbcuni.com>
Sent: Tuesday, September 19, 2017 4:53 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: RE: A's Pregame Live 
 
Hello again,
I have some finalized topics for you:
-overall state of the Tigers right now
-what does the future hold for Kinsler and Cabrera
Do these topics and your hit time work for you?
360 Third Street | Suite 200 | San Francisco, CA 94107

From: McCaffrey, Lauren (NBCUniversal) 
Sent: Tuesday, September 19, 2017 12:23 PM
To: 'afenech@freepress.com'
Subject: A's Pregame Live
I am the producer for A’s Pregame live; thank you for coming on our show today! I have your hit right at 6:15. Could you please meet our camera by the A’s dugout about 5 minutes prior to get set up?

I will get back to you with topics. We will probably want to ask about Chad Bell as well as the general state of the Tigers (traded Verlander, look to be starting a rebuild process). Please let me know if there is anything coming out of the clubhouse that you would like to speak on.
360 Third Street | Suite 200 | San Francisco, CA 94107
